title: Uttar Pradesh ‘Project GANGA’ Rural High-Speed Broadband

items: **Digital Connectivity Mission:** Government of Uttar Pradesh rolled out **Project GANGA** to deliver fiber-to-the-home (FTTH) high-speed broadband to over **20 Lakh rural households** across 75 districts over a 2- to 3-year timeline.

blocks.content: 🎯 Exam Angle → Project GANGA is UP’s rural broadband connectivity mission targeting 20 Lakh+ households.
